map.分项管理装修预算,实时计算总额与占比,支持本地保存: Manage renovation budget by item, compute total and share in real time, support local saving
map.「分项管理装修预算,实时计算总额与占比,支持本地保存」按输入参数进行专业计算并输: 'Manage renovation budget by item, compute total and share in real time, support local saving' computes professionally by input parameters and outputs results.
map.📖 查看「装修预算 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for Renovation Budget
map.硬装 / 主材 / 家具 / 家电分项列支，实时看各项占比，发现主材超 40%: Hard decor / main material / furniture / appliances listed by item, see each share in real time; if main material exceeds 40%, adjust structure promptly.
map.设总预算上限，用累计进度看已花比例，避免末端超支无钱收尾。: Set a total budget cap, use cumulative progress to see spent ratio, avoid running out of money at the end.
map.用浏览器 localStorage 存草稿，分多次录入；换设备前先截图 / 导出: Use browser localStorage to save drafts, enter multiple times; screenshot/export backup before changing devices.
map.算例（硬装 8 + 主材 12 + 家具 5 + 家电 4 万）: Example (hard decor 8 + main material 12 + furniture 5 + appliances 4, unit: 10,000 CNY)
map.合计 29 万；占比 硬装 27.6%、主材 41.4%、家具 17.2%、家电: Total 290,000 CNY; share hard decor 27.6%, main material 41.4%, furniture 17.2%, appliances 13.8%. If the total cap is 300,000 CNY, main material is near the ceiling; compress or lower the appliance tier.
map.各项占比怎么看健康？: How to read each share as healthy?
map.常见区间：硬装 25–35%、主材 30–45%、家具 15–25%、家电 10: Common ranges: hard decor 25-35%, main material 30-45%, furniture 15-25%, appliances 10-20%. Main material >45% or hard decor <20% are both unbalanced; the former squeezes soft decor, the latter may hide extra items.
map.数据存在哪、会丢吗？: Where is the data stored, will it be lost?
map.仅存浏览器 localStorage（按域名隔离），清缓存 / 换浏览器会丢。重: Stored only in browser localStorage (isolated by domain); clearing cache/changing browser loses it. Important budgets screenshot or export yourself; this tool does not network, does not upload.
